relationships.description: Each project belongs to one selected client, making the client available whenever a project is selected for operational work, reporting, or billing.

realization.description: The MDM relationship edge associates the project identity with the client identity.

relationships.description: Each client-user association identifies the client whose related published information the user may review.

realization.description: ClientUserAssociation.clientId references the organization-managed client.

relationships.description: Each client-user association identifies the external platform user authorized as that client's user.

realization.description: ClientUserAssociation.userId references the external platform user identity.

relationships.description: Each work task belongs to one selected project.

realization.description: WorkTask.projectId references the selected project.

relationships.description: Each work task has one directly assigned eligible platform worker or subcontractor; this association supports assigned-work access scope.

realization.description: WorkTask.assignedUserId references the assigned external platform user.

relationships.description: Each task dependency identifies the work task that must precede its successor in the project work sequence.

realization.description: TaskDependency.predecessorWorkTaskId identifies the prerequisite task.

relationships.description: Each task dependency identifies the work task that follows its predecessor in the project work sequence.

realization.description: TaskDependency.successorWorkTaskId identifies the task that follows the predecessor.

relationships.description: Each time log is recorded against one selected work task, from which its project context is available.

realization.description: TimeLog.workTaskId references the task receiving the recorded labor.

relationships.description: Each time log identifies the platform worker who performed and recorded the labor, enabling own-time enforcement.

realization.description: TimeLog.userId references the external worker who recorded the labor.

relationships.description: Each material-usage record belongs to one selected project.

realization.description: MaterialUsage.projectId references the project where material was consumed.

relationships.description: Each material-usage record identifies one selected material catalog item.

realization.description: MaterialUsage.materialId references the selected material catalog item.

relationships.description: Each change order belongs to one selected affected project.

realization.description: ChangeOrder.project references the affected project.

relationships.description: Each change order retains the platform user who submitted the proposed project change.

realization.description: ChangeOrder.submittedByUser references the external submitting user.

relationships.description: An approved or rejected change order retains the platform user who made its authorization decision.

realization.description: ChangeOrder.approvedByUser references the external decision-making user when present.

relationships.description: Each project schedule projection represents one project plan and its current schedule context.

realization.description: ProjectSchedule is derived for the project with the same projectId.

relationships.description: A project schedule projection includes the project's current work tasks, lifecycle progress, and dates.

realization.description: The derived workTaskIds collection contains tasks whose WorkTask.projectId matches the schedule projectId.

relationships.description: A project schedule projection includes directed task dependencies used to show planned work sequence and schedule risk.

realization.description: The derived taskDependencyIds collection contains dependency records for tasks in the schedule.

relationships.description: Each project cost summary projection represents one project's budget and current cost context.

realization.description: ProjectCostSummary is derived for the project with the same projectId.

relationships.description: A project cost summary derives actual labor activity from time logs belonging to the project's tasks.

realization.description: Labor cost is derived from TimeLog records whose work task has WorkTask.projectId equal to the summary projectId.

relationships.description: A project cost summary derives actual material cost from material usage belonging to the project.

realization.description: Material cost is derived from MaterialUsage records with the same projectId.

relationships.description: A project cost summary derives approved project-change impacts from the project's change orders.

realization.description: Approved change impact is derived from ChangeOrder records whose project matches the summary projectId.

relationships.description: Each active-project portfolio entry represents one project satisfying the activeProject lifecycle predicate.

realization.description: Each portfolio entry is derived for an active project with the same projectId.

relationships.description: Each portfolio entry derives upcoming-work and schedule-health information from its project's schedule projection.

realization.description: Upcoming-work and schedule-health values are derived from the same project's schedule projection.

relationships.description: Each portfolio entry derives budget-versus-actual information from its project's cost summary projection.

realization.description: Budget and actual-cost values are derived from the same project's cost summary projection.

relationships.description: Each generated status report belongs to one selected project and reaches its related client through that project.

realization.description: StatusReport.projectId references the project represented by the retained report.

relationships.description: Each generated status report identifies the project manager platform user who generated it.

realization.description: StatusReport.generatedByUserId references the external user who generated the report.

relationships.description: Each delay-risk finding belongs to one generated status-report snapshot.

realization.description: StatusReportRisk.statusReportId references its generated report snapshot.

relationships.description: Each delay-risk finding identifies the unfinished work task evaluated as at risk when the report was generated.

realization.description: StatusReportRisk.workTaskId identifies the task evaluated as at risk.

relationships.description: Each invoice bills one selected project and has that project's cost and approved-change context.

realization.description: Invoice.projectId references the billed project.

relationships.description: Each invoice identifies the related project client, supporting client-specific billing access and presentation.

realization.description: Invoice.clientId references the client receiving the billing summary.

relationships.description: Each invoice line belongs to one invoice and forms part of its published billing summary.

realization.description: InvoiceLine.invoiceId references the invoice containing the published line.

relationships.description: Each labor allocation identifies the invoice that includes the labor activity.

realization.description: InvoiceLaborAllocation.invoiceId references the invoice containing the labor allocation.

relationships.description: Each labor allocation identifies the time log included in billing.

realization.description: InvoiceLaborAllocation.timeLogId references the billed labor record.

relationships.description: Each material allocation identifies the invoice that includes the material activity.

realization.description: InvoiceMaterialAllocation.invoiceId references the invoice containing the material allocation.

relationships.description: Each material allocation identifies the material-usage record included in billing.

realization.description: InvoiceMaterialAllocation.materialUsageId references the billed material-usage record.

relationships.description: Each change-order allocation identifies the invoice that includes the approved change amount.

realization.description: InvoiceChangeOrderAllocation.invoiceId references the invoice containing the change allocation.
